lcc_original: 上帝創造他們、有男有女。當他們被創造的日子，上帝賜福與他們，給他們起名叫「人」【1】。
notes: UNV 造 → LCC 創造 for bara H01254; SNs attached to 創造 and 被創造 respectively for both occurrences
UNV has {<WH08034>} implicit (no explicit 名 in 稱他們為) but LCC has explicit 名 in 起名 — braces dropped per rule 3: 起名<WH08034>
起名叫 split between two Hebrew roots: 起名<WH08034> for shem, 叫<WH07121><WTH8799> for qara

WAH0853 appears twice: explicitly on 與他們<WAH0853> (blessing them) matching UNV 給他們<WAH0853>; implicitly {<WAH0853>} placed after 叫 (the accusative marker on שְׁמָם has no explicit Chinese equivalent in LCC's 起名叫 construction)
LCC 上帝 substitutes for UNV 神 (Elohim); neither is SN-tagged in source UNV so none added
